title: CareerPilot – AI-Powered Job Search Assistant
description: AI-driven job search platform that matches job listings to your CV using semantic search, fit scoring, and a multi-provider LLM layer for cover letter generation.
readmeDescription: CareerPilot is an AI-powered career platform for job seekers that parses uploaded CVs, indexes them into a vector database using Gemini embeddings, and performs RAG-grounded job fit scoring against live listings scraped from major job boards. It features an AI assistant for cover letter generation, saved jobs, search history, and an application progress tracker — all backed by Supabase and deployed on Vercel.

title: BrewMind – Local-First Ollama Workspace
description: A local-first AI workspace for chatting with Ollama models, organizing conversations into projects called Brews, and benchmarking hardware to recommend suitable local models.
readmeDescription: BrewMind is a desktop-inspired Next.js application that provides a streamlined interface for interacting with locally hosted Ollama models. Users can organize chats into project-based workspaces called Brews, customize themes and fonts, attach documents and images, render markdown and LaTeX content, and persist all data locally using IndexedDB. The platform also includes a browser-side benchmarking system that evaluates hardware performance and helps users select appropriate models for local AI workloads, all without requiring a remote backend.

title: BikriHobe – AI-Powered Campus Marketplace
description: AI-driven second-hand marketplace with computer vision to automatically assess item condition and generate quality confidence scores.
readmeDescription: EconHub is an AI-powered campus marketplace designed to streamline second-hand item selling for university students. It uses a custom computer vision model to automatically verify the condition of uploaded items and generates an unbiased 'quality confidence score', helping build trust between buyers and sellers.

title: Few-Shot Learning for Defect Detection in RMG Garments
description: Researching few-shot learning techniques to identify and classify defects in garment manufacturing with minimal training data.
readmeDescription: Ongoing research project focusing on utilizing few-shot learning methodologies to classify defects in readymade garments (RMG) without needing vast datasets. This significantly reduces the overhead involved in annotating massive visual datasets for new types of defects.

title: Transport Management System (TMS)
description: Engineered a comprehensive fleet logistics platform with multi-step ticketing and real-time seat availability tracking.
readmeDescription: A comprehensive database-focused project utilizing Prisma ORM and PostgreSQL to route, schedule, and ticket regional fleet vehicles. The system handles live seat availability logic and concurrency transactions seamlessly.

title: Acadex – Unified Academic Workspace
description: Built a feature-rich note-taking and scheduling platform with rich text editing using Tiptap and OCR.
readmeDescription: Acadex centralizes the student experience by unifying advanced rich-text notes with built-in OCR integration right into your workflow. Features collaborative group editing and class scheduling powered by a highly reliable Supabase backend.

title: CashBlock – Budget Management App
description: Designed and deployed a brutalist-aesthetic budget tracker with category-based transaction management and PWA.
readmeDescription: CashBlock offers a uniquely brutalist UI design approach to personal finance. Being an installable Progressive Web App (PWA), users can leverage lightning-fast budget entries with category segmentation right from their mobile homescreens.

title: MiniMinds – Interactive Learning App for Kids
description: Created offline-first educational application with 6+ engaging mini-games for early childhood learning.
readmeDescription: MiniMinds is built from the ground up using JavaFX to provide a completely offline-first, vibrant, and interactive learning environment. It features more than six interconnected mini-games focused on teaching arithmetic, spelling, and cognitive patterns.

title: SPREAD – Disease Transmission Simulator
description: Developed interactive disease spread simulator using agent-based modeling with probabilistic infection transmission.
readmeDescription: Leveraging Pygame to visually simulate viral spread mathematically over geographical populations using agent-based modeling. SPREAD lets users toggle infection proximity, transmission probability, and social isolation algorithms to understand pandemic dynamics.

title: TaskLoop – Task Management CLI
description: Built task management CLI with group-based organization and integrated timer functionality.
readmeDescription: TaskLoop represents an entirely self-contained, lightweight C++ and SQLite driven Command Line Interface tool for developers. It supports grouping tasks efficiently and utilizes a local database memory approach to be blazingly fast.
